text:
leah_ae: Opening Scorpion POC perf thread. Prospect acceptance asks: sustain 850 qps, p95 < 125ms, and clear KMS/HSM behavior + a short hourly POC estimate. Need runbook, smoke numbers, and a cost delta for envelope encryption.
omar_eng: Recommended model: rdx-6b-quant for headroom. Dedicated cluster, autoscale off for deterministic numbers. Typical payloads: ~330 tokens in / ~130 tokens out.
tia_sre: Cluster sizing: start with 13 nodes. Warmup plan: 12m prefix & KV priming, then 35m steady, include a 7m 1100 qps spike to test headroom. Use Poisson arrivals from 25 clients.
noah_sec: For KMS: we'll show cached-envelope vs strict-unwrap-each-request. Provide audit log flow and key rotation notes for their compliance team.
leah_ae: Can you paste a compact runbook I can forward plus the metrics we will return? Also need a $/1M tokens delta and hourly POC estimate.
omar_eng: Load plan (short): ramp 0->850 qps over 12m, sustain 35m, spike 7m @1100 qps, teardown 3m. Capture p50/p90/p95/p99, GPU util, CPU offload, KV hit rate, and end-to-end token/sec.
omar_eng: Vegeta smoke (one-liner):
vegeta attack -rate=850 -duration=35m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type='hist[0,50,100,125,200,400,800]' > scorpion.run
tia_sre: I'll run four variants: baseline (no encryption), envelope-cache, envelope-no-cache, and strict-KMS-unwrap.
deploy-bot: perf-job-scorpion-4951234567 started on dedicated-cluster-12.
tia_sre: Early smoke (cache warmed): baseline p95 ~112ms, envelope-cache p95 ~132ms, no-cache p95 ~150ms, strict-unwrap p95 ~175ms. p99s: baseline 245ms, strict-unwrap 420ms. GPU util ~70% steady.
leah_ae: Good. Noah, can you draft the short security blurb for the questionnaire (key rotation + audit)?
noah_sec: Draft: "Customer CMKs remain in their KMS/HSM. Redwood uses envelope encryption: ephemeral envelope keys are generated per-node and cached to meet latency SLOs. Unwrap operations use the customer's KMS; all unwrap and key-access events are logged and can be forwarded to the customer's audit endpoint (CloudTrail/Splunk). Envelope keys rotate by default every 24h; CMK rotations follow customer KMS policy. For FIPS/HSM requests we support CloudHSM/Azure Dedicated HSM and can provide attestation artifacts on request."
leah_ae: Perfect. Omar/Tia, cost sketch for AE pack please.
tia_sre: Node cost example $3.15/hr -> 13 nodes ~= $40.95/hr. Baseline compute token cost estimate ~$1.05 per 1M tokens. Envelope-cache adds ~+14% compute overhead -> roughly +$0.15 per 1M tokens. Strict-unwrap adds ~+38% -> roughly +$0.40 per 1M tokens (includes KMS egress). I'll draft a short table.
omar_eng: Note: with strict-unwrap we saw occasional p99 spikes tied to KMS regional latency. Recommend showing both modes so they understand tradeoffs. Also mention envelope-cache TTL param we used: ENVELOPE_CACHE_TTL=3600.
eil_ops: (ops message) If they need HSM attestation, ops will schedule retrieval time; expect ~3-5 business days for formal artifacts.
leah_ae: Action items: omar upload abridged run-report + PNGs, tia upload raw vegeta + metrics tar, noah paste the security blurb into their questionnaire, tia produce the hourly POC quote and node config. I'll send AE pack after items land.
deploy-bot: perf-job-scorpion-4951234567 completed. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/scorpion/4951234567/results.tar.gz
leah_ae: Thanks all  I'll draft the email and attach artifacts. Ping here if they ask for longer soak or multi-region failover. :thumbsup:
